source: Onkelos on Exod 32:1-6; the dossier at Midrash Tanchuma, Ki Tisa 19
claim_en: Make us FEARED-ONES — the idol-word plural, THESE are your gods; Aaron's redirect: a festival BEFORE THE LORD tomorrow (Onkelos Exod 32). The spine's record: the sixth-hour miscount, Satan's bier-illusion, HUR KILLED for rebuking (Aaron understood from the slaughtered one), the delay-tactics — and the WOMEN'S REFUSAL, carried by the verse's own grammar: the rings came from THEIR ears, not their wives' (Midrash Tanchuma, Ki Tisa 19).

source: Onkelos on Exod 32:9-14; the destroyers at Midrash Tanchuma, Ki Tisa 20
claim_en: 'Let Me alone' rendered DESIST FROM YOUR PRAYER — the decree itself reveals that prayer restrains it; Moses PRAYED; the oath remembered BY YOUR WORD; and the LORD TURNED BACK from the evil — the first recorded successful intercession against a standing decree (Onkelos Exod 32). The five destroyers, three dismissed at the patriarchs' names, the You-take-one-I-take-one division at the breach (Midrash Tanchuma, Ki Tisa 20).

source: Onkelos on Exod 32:15-19; the breaking dispute at Midrash Tanchuma, Ki Tisa 30
claim_en: Written both sides; the writing of God MEFARASH — the clear-script token of the stones and the plate now on the tablets themselves; the letters FLEW and the tablets grew heavy (Onkelos Exod 32). The breaking's recorded reasons dispute: R. Ishmael's a-fortiori from the Passover's stranger-ban, R. Akiva's He-commanded, the torn-contract defense (Midrash Tanchuma, Ki Tisa 30).

source: Onkelos on Exod 32:20; the triage at Midrash Tanchuma, Ki Tisa 26
claim_en: Burned, ground, scattered on the water, and Israel MADE TO DRINK — the suspected wife's test at national scale (Onkelos Exod 32); and the spine completes the decision-tree: witnesses AND warning, the sword; warning without witnesses, THE WATER TEST as the sotah is tested; neither, the plague — a complete evidentiary triage in the tradition's own words (Midrash Tanchuma, Ki Tisa 26).

Whoever FEARS the LORD, to me — the gate-to-gate execution, three thousand — and the fill-the-hand idiom again at 32:29: the Levites' ordination effected BY the crisis-loyalty itself, office earned at the breach (Onkelos Exod 32; EX28-01's decoding met a second time).

Blot me from YOUR BOOK — refused: whoever sinned before Me, HIM I blot from My book — the registry surfaces and substitution is denied; and the open ledger: on the day of My accounting I will account (Onkelos Exod 32) — the spine dates it to the Day of Atonement and seals the canon: He is long-suffering AND COLLECTS.

THY people = the mixed multitude Moses accepted on his own word ('better to receive the penitent') — 'these are THY gods,' not ours: the converts' calf, and the intake-decision owned by its maker; the 125-talent gematria rides; and the manna DID NOT STOP even that day — the not-withheld grace (Midrash Tanchuma, Ki Tisa 21). Seated under the amended spine, auto-seat law.

THE CALF VERSE'S LAW LAYER. The Noahide idolatry source ('they turned quickly from the way I COMMANDED: they MADE a calf'), with the recorded FORK — a gentile who made an idol without worshiping is liable from the making on this arm, only on worship on the Hosea arm; the arms unassigned between Rav Chisda and Rav Yitzchak bar Avdimi. Accepting-as-god equated to worship by the verse's own three-verb hekesh (they bowed, they sacrificed, they SAID). And the vav of he'elukha holding the verdict — but for that letter, annihilation (R. Yochanan; Acherim's arm), the plural read as craving many gods under the joining ban. Filed F-095, auto-seated (round 25, the capital block).

source: Onkelos Exod 32:9-14, 32:20, 32:26-29, 32:32-35; Yoma 66b:13-15, 86b:14; Avodah Zarah 44a:2, 53b:10; Rosh Hashanah 16b:14; Berakhot 32a:14-24; Sanhedrin 56b:10, 63a:14, 63a:17, 102a:15; Megillah 25b:11-12; Shabbat 89a:6; Arakhin 15b:18; Eruvin 54a:19; Mishnah Avodah Zarah 3:2-3, 4:2, 4:4, Sanhedrin 7:6, Megillah 4:10
claim_en: THE CALF'S LAW LAYER: Exod 32 compiled in cold_run_erection.py — the three death-verbs (sword, plague, water) as the court's evidentiary tiers (Yoma 66b); 32:20's four verbs the nullification dispute's ground and its fourth verb the sages' answer (a sotah test, not a precedent); the plural formula proving the intent; the intercession on the vows' law; the three books from 32:32's three tokens; the reading law's boundary on the chapter's tokens.
